name: Practice: Ch7 Inference for Numerical Data (Final-Exam Review)

source.purpose: Final Semester 2 review for Ch7 (Weeks 7-10). Ch7 IND avg 86.0% is the lowest of any S2 chapter test — significantly weaker than Ch6 (90.9%) or Ch8 (92.2%). FRQs were the dominant misses (IND q7 ANOVA when-to-use 56%, q6 single-mean p-value 68%; group q13 ANOVA 44%, q12 paired interpretation 55%). The mixed-review HW had 47-54% incomplete rates on two-sample/paired items — engagement and retention drop significantly across the four Ch7 inference types.

hw_scrape_findings: Mixed Review 7.1-7.3 (22263279) is a major retention failure: overall 82.5% (lowest of any HW in S2), 40-54% incomplete rates on the harder two-sample and paired items, q12 unequal-variance CI at 50%. Final review must drill cross-section integration with retry-friendly auto-graded items.

Ch7 IND avg 86.0% is dragged primarily by two FRQs (q6 68%, q7 56%) and slightly weaker auto-graded items (q2 two-pop mean 93%, q4 ANOVA table 93%) — but the FRQs are the dominant cost. Three FRQ reuses + new auto-graded interpretation drills should close the gap.
ANOVA had no representation in HW item analysis (no HW 7.5) but was IND q4 (93%, ANOVA table) + q5 (95%) + q7 (56%, FRQ). Conceptual ANOVA understanding is the weakest single area in Ch7.

Repo coverage for Ch7 is thin: only 3 inference-for-means files (sleep/reaction/steps) and 3 two-sample files (q13-q15). 9 drafts needed to close auto-graded gaps, especially in 7.2 paired-t and 7.5 ANOVA.

planning_notes.frq_strategy: All 3 FRQs reuse questions/frq/inference-for-means/ — q2 (single-mean p-value, drills IND q6 68%), q5 (paired interp, drills group q12 55%), q9 (ANOVA interp, drills IND q7 56% / group q13 44%).
planning_notes.selection_priority: Heavy draft burden because Ch7 repo coverage is thin. Drafts focus on: abstract one-mean computation (slot 3), CI mean interpretation (slot 4), paired-t workflow (slot 7), paired vs two-sample decision (slot 8), two-sample CI/HT (slots 11-12, drills 47.8% incomplete), ANOVA when-to-use + summary table + conclusion (slots 13-15), state H0/Ha for mean (slot 16). 7 reuses pull from Ch4-5 foundations (one-mean CI/HT/decision/setup/Type I-II/conclusion); 3 from existing inference-for-means / two-sample-inference repo files.
